title: Probability: code and results for the fatigue reliability of a titanium femoral locking plate
description: Calibrated finite element model, Gaussian process surrogate, Monte Carlo, FORM and Sobol analyses of the ASTM F382 four-point bending fatigue test of a grade 4 titanium femoral locking plate, with a model-form variance decomposition. Computational study based on published data only. Supports the manuscript 'Model-form uncertainty outweighs input scatter in the fatigue reliability of a titanium femoral locking plate'.
